entries.fad5a99e05a8d28a: Toward realizing its mission, “Making the impossible possible for people around the world,” the company states it will focus its management strategy on recruiting and developing talent, continuous investment in research and development, and fostering a corporate culture that generates innovation. As issues to address, it cites establishing a strong revenue base by strengthening and expanding its stock-type business model, and it states it will also work on strengthening its business through generative AI and expanding its API solutions business.
